caption: The drawing depicts two transparent, broken drinking glasses placed side by side on a plain, light-colored background. Each glass has a noticeable missing section along the rim. The glass on the left features an etched or faintly drawn image of a house with several windows and a circular structure, possibly a fountain, in front of it, with architectural details visible through the surface of the glass. The glass on the right also displays a lightly rendered house, but this one has a chimney and horizontal siding lines, and there is a tree branch or twig etched near the rim. Both glasses are shaded to represent their cylindrical form and a sense of three-dimensionality. The overall color palette consists mainly of soft grays, clear tones, and subtle hints of brown and green in the shading, emphasizing the transparency of the glass material. The background is a plain off-white, and the artist’s signature, “Chris Makiens,” appears centered below the glasses.
title: Whiskey Glass
